text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the gatehouse tablet freezing at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging?
reply_text:
I answered Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-random: the ticket is **#88412**.

Tobias raised it in #central-team on Jul 2, 2025 as a Tier 2 support escalation. The gatehouse tablet at Door 6 was freezing on the BOL (bill of lading) barcode scan, apparently when Quarendon Freightways drivers arrived with split manifests. He confirmed in the same thread that it was Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so this is something they can see themselves. I checked that before reading the channel.

A different Door 6 ticket for Tansleigh, **#4912**, also came up. That one is about a phantom lock on Dock Door 6 at their Marietta plant, and it only appears in an email Hollis may not have access to. It doesn't match the tablet freeze anyway, so I left it out of the reply.

text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply? Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random: the ticket is **PD-4821**.

Hollis mentioned it in #central-team on Jun 9, 2026, and Tobias is a member of that channel. The Eastbank receiving-door import is attached to that ticket. The import file labels the doors E1/E2 while the booking sheet uses 01/02, and that needs fixing before anyone reimports, or there will be duplicates.

The search also turned up a ticket called **#PD-88412** under the Marrow accounts. It covers a different issue, so I left it out to avoid confusion.
